head: special button (flat underside)
notes: Team Chevelle forum reply (cowl screen screw context). GM 1979 supersession list: 3893979 use 9431918 (no size found for 9431918). Head described as special button head, flat underside.

sources.title: Screw P/N 3893979. What is it? | Team Chevelle
sources.quote: Desert, 3893979 is a #8 x 3/8" black phillips trim screw with a special button head which is flat on the under side.
